messages:
jamie (ml eng): quick heads-up — trying to onboard aurelia-lite-2.1. two blockers: license says `research and non-commercial use only` (model card attached), and tokenizer appears to be a sentencepiece variant that maps some punctuation differently vs our spm vocab. can infra/legal take a look? :eyes:

matt (infra): +1 on the weights path confusion. deploy-bot shows upload complete but our ingestion job expects `container://models/...` not `azure://`. can you paste the exact path?

deploy-bot: uploaded weights to azure://redwood-prod/models/aurelia-lite/2.1/weights/ (sha256: a3f4...c9e7). index file name `pytorch_model-00001-of-00002.bin` present.

jamie (ml eng): path is `azure://redwood-prod/models/aurelia-lite/2.1/weights/`. I ran a quick local tokenize test and saw this:
```
>>> tok.encode("Hello, world!")
[50273, 6, 129, 2]   # our spm: comma token is 6
>>> sp.encode("Hello, world!")
[50273, 14, 129, 2]  # upstream: comma token 14
```
so same input yields different token ids (prefix/kvcache mismatch in serving tests).

kai (serving): tokenizer id mismatch will break kv cache reuse and quantization alignment. we can add a tokenizer mapping layer at load time but prefer to use the upstream tokenizer binary if available. is there a `tokenizer.json` or `spiece.model` in the artifact?

jamie (ml eng): yes there's `spiece.model` included. my local loader used a fallback converter which caused remapping.

olivia (legal): quick read: the model card attachment shows CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 style phrasing + an explicit "non-commercial use only" clause in the README. that license forbids commercial exploitation — serving as a paid API would likely violate it. do we have product/marketing owners for this model?

sofia (product): tagging — we don't have a customer committed yet; goal was to enable hosted evals only. if license restricts commercial hosting, we could still host in a research sandbox for eval but must not enable public/paid endpoints. is that acceptable?

olivia (legal): that would be acceptable only if access is strictly limited to internal/test accounts and no commercial SLA. also need upstream attribution in model card and retention of license text in our UI where we surface model info. for any enterprise/dedicated usage we need an explicit commercial license from the model provider.

matt (infra): on the ingestion side — I pushed a small config patch to accept `azure://` scheme for the blob loader. quick diff: 
```yaml
model_sources:
  - name: azure_blob
    scheme: azure://
    container_root: redwood-prod/models
```
This unblocks the pipeline; will roll in a hotfix to staging.

kai (serving): for tokenization mismatch, plan: if we load `spiece.model` from artifact and initialize sentencepiece exactly, that should match upstream ids. jamie, can you confirm current loader path uses our fallback converter? If so I can add a lazy loader toggle `--use-upstream-tokenizer` to model config.

jamie (ml eng): confirmed — current ingestion converted spiece -> tokenizer.json using our compat script. I'll re-upload a clean artifact with the original `spiece.model` and mark ingestion to prefer it.

olivia (legal): action items from legal side: 1) we need a short note added to model card UI: "License: Non-commercial — contact legal for commercial licensing" 2) keep the original license files in the artifact 
(please @me when the artifact is final).

sofia (product): timeline? if infra and jamie can get artifact + ingestion change in staging today, legal review can confirm text and we can enable internal evals by EOD. is that realistic?

matt (infra): pushing azure scheme fix to staging now, should be live in ~30m.

kai (serving): I'll add `--use-upstream-tokenizer` flag and a small unit test to assert token id parity; PR incoming shortly.

jamie (ml eng): uploading new artifact now (contains spiece.model, license.txt, model_card.md). will post SHA and update the ingestion job once upload completes.

deploy-bot: artifact upload complete — azure://redwood-prod/models/aurelia-lite/2.1/weights/sha256=a3f4...c9e7, includes `spiece.model`, `license.txt`, `model_card.md`.

olivia (legal): thanks — will review license.txt + model_card.md and post confirmation here. if we need to reach out upstream for a commercial addendum I'll start the thread.

sofia (product): perfect. jamie/kai/matt — please ping when staging can run a full serve test (token parity + kv cache behavior). once legal signs off, we keep this as "internal eval only" until we secure commercial rights. :thumbsup:
